notes: Verbatim VAR_INFO_DEFINITION text from one site's (US-MMS) BIFVARINFO_DD file's GRP_VAR_INFO group, for every one of the 146 daily-resolution GPP/RECO/NEE-uncertainty-family columns -- all 146 had a definition (0 missing). The fluxnet R package exposes an equivalent flux_varinfo() reader over the same BIFVARINFO source; reading the CSV directly was equivalent and avoided an extra dependency for a one-off lookup. Definitions use ONEFlux's own template language per family (method x VUT/CUT x REF/MEAN/SE/USTAR50/percentile) and are reproduced verbatim including one upstream wording inconsistency (NEE_VUT_USTAR50's own definition text says '(CUT)' where context makes clear it means VUT -- quoted as-is, not corrected).
